title: Ask, Don't Guess: Targeted Clarification for Speech Recognition Errors
abstract: arXiv:2610.24809v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speech recognition in real time in far-field conversational settings still incurs significant errors. Identifying potential error spans during streaming ASR permits a recourse mechanism where the speaker can be asked to repeat the affected content under cleaner acoustic conditions. We propose PARDON, a new framework for online error localization, that identifies spans likely to benefit from this intervention. Our supervision uses clean audio to estimate how the recognizer's output might change under improved acoustic conditions. We probabilistically align noisy and clean decodes using a pair-HMM to obtain soft supervision. These soft targets train a counterfactual gain scorer by combining a suite of acoustic and language features to produce token-level scores, that are further grouped into spans for targeted recourse. translated_title: 询问而非猜测：针对语音识别错误的定向澄清机制
translated_abstract: 在远场对话场景下的实时语音识别仍然存在显著错误。在流式自动语音识别（ASR）过程中识别潜在的错误片段，可以实现一种补救机制：请说话人在更清晰的声学条件下重复受影响的内容。我们提出了PARDON，一个用于在线错误定位的新框架，它能识别出可能从这种干预中受益的片段。我们的监督方法利用干净音频来估计在声学条件改善后识别器的输出可能发生怎样的变化。我们使用成对隐马尔可夫模型（pair-HMM）对含噪解码与干净解码进行概率对齐，从而获得软监督信号。这些软目标用于训练一个反事实增益评分器，该评分器结合一整套声学与语言特征，产生词元级别的分数，并进一步将这些分数聚合为片段，以实现定向补救。随后，大语言模型（LLM）利用重复内容的ASR转录结果，仅对被选定的片段进行修正。在70%的精确率下，PARDON实现了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PARDON框架，通过基于干净音频软监督训练的反事实增益评分器在线定位流式语音识别中可能出错的片段，请说话人重复该内容，并让大语言模型仅修正被选中的片段，从而实现“主动询问而非盲目猜测”的定向澄清式错误补救。
en_tdlr: PARDON is an online error-localization framework that uses a counterfactual gain scorer (trained with soft supervision from clean audio via pair-HMM alignment) to identify likely ASR error spans during streaming, prompts the speaker to repeat the affected content, and lets an LLM revise only the flagged span for targeted clarification.
